Who is Gesane?

When first speaks to , he greets him and asks if he needs something. asks who he is, so introduces himself. When asks about the , recites a saying about the and is surprised has never heard it. He encourages to visit , should he have a chance.

Once has obtained the "" , he can ask about 's whereabouts. reveals that left for the to prepare to avenge . He explains that, since the is where warriors train, went there to stock up on and . If asked about the , directs him to on the other side of . Due to the difficulty of traveling around , suggests take the western path.

After has been calmed, will note that has come at a good time now that the trouble is gone. He asks if needs something, which replies to by asking how is. He has nothing to complain about in his life, but then he reveals that he saw a when he went on a walk earlier. He clarifies that it is a giant monster made of enchanted , and he thought it was both incredible and terrifying. He thinks he saw it in , but he ended up fleeing very quickly. Despite its size, believes a could take it down easily. This begins the "" .

When speaks to again, he can ask about the . explains that it is made of enchanted , and he says that should be avoided because of it. Though he is good at fighting, would not want to face a .
